description: This source file implements AI movement logic for the game 'Wesnoth', including target selection, pathfinding, group movement, and threat assessment.

classes.name: move_cost_calculator
classes.description: Calculates movement cost for a unit considering terrain, enemies, and other factors.

methods.name: ai::find_targets
methods.description: Finds potential targets for a given leader and enemy movements, including threats, villages, and explicit targets.

methods.name: ai::form_group
methods.description: Forms a group of units along a route, considering reachability and movement constraints.

methods.name: ai::enemies_along_path
methods.description: Identifies enemy units along a given movement path.

methods.name: ai::move_group
methods.description: Moves a group of units along a route, considering defense and positioning.

methods.name: ai::rate_group
methods.description: Rates the strength of a group of units based on defense, attack, and hitpoints.

methods.name: ai::compare_groups
methods.description: Compares the strength of two groups to determine relative advantage.

methods.name: ai::choose_move
methods.description: Selects the best move for units to pursue targets, considering pathfinding, threats, and grouping.

methods.name: ai::access_points
methods.description: Finds accessible points along a route for a unit to reach a destination.
